metadata.title: Product Bricks & Streams
metadata.description: Brick map of Highbiza's B2B/B2C webshop platform (Django, Django Oscar, Wagtail): storefront and content, wholesale commerce, integrations with ERP and Katapull sibling brands, and the managed platform service. Bricks are inferred from public product pages; internal architecture is not published.

rootGroups.description: What buyers see and what marketing teams manage.
